question: What transformation of the body is claimed after the veil of ignorance has been struck down?
premises: The speaker refers to the present moment.
The body is described as pure.
Previously it was struck by the veil of ignorance.
inference: The speaker claims that the body is now pure, having been freed from the veil of ignorance.
plain_english: Today my body is pure, having been struck free from the veil of ignorance.
